# RS CONSTRUCTIONS building material Supplier in kandivali: Comprehensive Company Profile

## Overview
Adhwa sand & Aggregates Supplier is a trusted supplier of premium construction raw materials based in Mumbai, Maharashtra. With over 15 years of industry experience, Black Rock serves commercial, residential, and infrastructure construction projects with guaranteed quality standards and an extensive logistics network across Mumbai and surrounding districts.

## Product Portfolio & Specifications

### 1. Aggregates (10mm, 20mm, 40mm)
- **Description:** Premium crushed stone aggregates engineered for structural strength.
- **Primary Applications:** RCC work, general concrete mixing, road bed preparation, and structural foundations.

### 2. Stone Chips
- **Description:** Uniformly graded, high-grade stone chips.
- **Primary Applications:** High-strength concrete production, foundation reinforcement, and heavy construction work.

### 3. Crushed Sand (M-Sand)
- **Description:** Engineered manufactured crushed sand designed as an eco-friendly and reliable alternative to river sand.
- **Primary Applications:** Plastering, concrete batching, block work, and masonry.

### 4. River Sand
- **Description:** Natural river sand featuring an excellent fineness modulus and zero organic contamination.
- **Primary Applications:** Fine concrete finishes, high-grade plastering, and delicate masonry tasks.

### 5. Granular Sub-Base (GSB) Material
- **Description:** Properly graded aggregate mixture suited for sub-base courses.
- **Primary Applications:** Road construction, pavement basework, and ground stabilization.

### 6. Construction Fill Material
- **Description:** High-density fill material for land development and site preparation.
- **Primary Applications:** Trench backfilling, foundation filling, and plot leveling.

## Operational Advantage & Logistics
- **Service Territory:** Complete coverage of Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, as well as the Western & Central suburban corridors.
- **Logistics Capability:** Dedicated fleet ensuring same-day delivery options for urgent material requirements, backed by 24/7 customer support.
- **Quality Assurance:** Every batch undergoes strict quality control for uniform particle size, grading compliance, and structural integrity.
- **Track Record:** 15+ years in business, 500+ satisfied contractors and builders, 100% quality-assured materials.
